rationale: Dev is building low-code AI orchestration infrastructure at Gooey.AI while actively hiring software engineers; Jiale is a systems engineer and ML researcher at Meta with deep expertise in distributed training systems and scalable ML platforms. Their skill sets are highly complementary—Jiale's infrastructure and systems background directly complements Dev's need for strong engineers to build and scale production AI systems, and both have worked at the intersection of developer tooling and ML infrastructure.
intro_message: Dev Aggarwal, meet Jiale Zhi — Jiale's experience building distributed training and ML infrastructure systems at Meta and Uber could be valuable as you scale Gooey.AI's orchestration platform and grow your engineering team.
